sql:
SELECT month, SalesAmount, prev_SalesAmount, if(prev_SalesAmount = 0, NULL, (SalesAmount - prev_SalesAmount) / prev_SalesAmount * 100) AS GrowthRatePercent
FROM (
    SELECT toMonth(DateKey) AS month, sum(SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount, any(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toMonth(DateKey) ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_SalesAmount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY month
)
ORDER BY month
